extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and contributors attempting to create or locate a specific article (new page creators / editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who are trying to create or find a Wikipedia article (here: 'Joe Rogan (albums)'), including account requirements, searching for existing content, handling recent-creation delays, title/redirect conventions, and deletion checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Joe Rogan (albums)" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for similar or existing pages before creating a new one to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inbound links can indicate whether the topic is already covered under another title or should have its own page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handle recent-creation visibility delays
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the only difference is capitalization or minor spelling, create a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons to understand issues (notability, sourcing, etc.) before attempting recreation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request-creation process
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For new contributors or potentially non-notable topics, submitting a draft or requesting an article helps ensure community review and reduces deletion risk.
